## Group-A is commissioned: reading whole groups of people

**2026-10-20** · commissioned · Commissioned

On 278 healthy people from a new laboratory, a 1 % change planted into half of them was found at more than seven times the noise.

Record: [COMMISSIONING_NOTE_GROUPA.md](doors/COMMISSIONING_NOTE_GROUPA.md)

## Every healthy cell follows the same simple rule

**2026-10-15** · commissioned, early result (data already read) · 53 of 56 on one line

Cells tag their DNA to remember what kind of cell they are, and make a few tagging mistakes. Across 56 kinds of healthy human cells, the number of mistakes depends on one thing: how much of the DNA the cell keeps loosely tagged. So what a healthy cell should look like comes from its own sample, not a library of other cells. Early result, one laboratory's data, counted with the earlier held-error counter. Since then: the line was rebuilt in the chain on the per-opportunity count and IAM-A was commissioned on it (2026-10-17, COMMISSIONING_NOTE_IAMA.md).

Record: [loose_end_line.py](../../development/loose_end_2026-10-15/loose_end_line.py)

**2026-10-15** · commissioned · 0.038

## Breast cancer: patients' tumors leave the healthy range far more often than chance

**2026-10-11** · development · 9x chance

Each woman's tumor was read against her own healthy breast tissue. Chance alone puts about 3 of 53 outside the healthy range; 23 were, and 41 of 53 tumors read above the woman's own tissue. The rule was sealed before a single tumor was opened.

Record: [DEV_TISSUE_BREAST_01_OUTCOME.md](doors/DEV_TISSUE_BREAST_01_OUTCOME.md)

## Colorectal cancer: the same signal, in a second cancer

**2026-10-11** · development · 6x chance

Chance alone puts about 4 of 88 outside the healthy range; 28 were, and 80 of 88 tumors read above the patient's own healthy colon. Sealed in advance, scored once.

Record: [DEV_TISSUE_COLON_01_OUTCOME.md](doors/DEV_TISSUE_COLON_01_OUTCOME.md)
